text_block_list.text: Big Bro! How was I?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Big Sis! How was I?!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
If you ask me, I think I did a pretty good
job!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
She ran well, and the results were along
what we
expected, but... I got the
feeling that she
wouldn't have been able
to keep it up for much
longer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
If I'm being completely honest, I think the
longer races might be too much for you.

text_block_list.text: But... I really do want the Triple Tiara.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Seeing her determination, I have a hard
time
breaking the news to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: I wouldn't say there's no chance at all, but...

text_block_list.text: It's okay. I get it.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: All right. No Triple Tiara, then!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I don't see any sign of resignation or
compromise
in her expression. All I can
see is... a sparkle in her
eyes gleaming
forward to the future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The tiara is something only possible to
attain in
your classic year. It's not
something you can put
off for
"someday."
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I trust your decision. Besides...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: I trust your decision. Besides...
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'll just have to shine brighter than the
Triple
Tiara, right?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
It's tough to throw away a dream. I'm
deeply
impressed by her ability to move
on.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've decided! I'm gonna put all my
energy into
sprints from now on!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I'll win all of them and travel a path even
cuter
than the Triple Tiara tour! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Now that she's made her decision,
there's a race
I'd like to propose to her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes is a G1 sprint where
the top
sprinter is decided, so I want to
set it as her next
big racing goal.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Wow! A G1! I like it. Perfect for my new
dream!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yep! A dream to take the place of the
tiara.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
A dream to win a big race and become
the most
beloved runner of all. ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Yep! No matter where she runs, the most
beloved
Umamusume will always be the
cutest.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Bathing in the spotlight with everyone
cheering
for me... That's, like, the
pinnacle of cute!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now I'm getting pumped! ♪ I'm
gonna do
my best to become the most
beloved runner!
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
As usual, Каррен Тян has a unique way
of
thinking. But G1 races are no walk in
the park. Is
this new direction really for
the best?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... isn't it a long time until that
race?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna have zero exposure until
then... Can
we decide on another race
too?
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
I was going to suggest that myself.
Alongside her
training, a good race to
act as a stepping stone
to her dream
would be...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It may be lower in status, but it'd be a
good way
to get reacquainted with a
1,200-meter race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it! It'll be the first step toward
my dream
of being the most beloved
runner.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
And so, we decide to set our sights on
the Aoi
Stakes!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...But not just the race. It might be time
to put "that"
into motion.
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text: Nothing! Let's do our best. ♪
